name: aixcut-codex-plugin
description: Aixcut Codex plugin for opening Aixcut Studio and editing video projects through the hosted Aixcut MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Open Aixcut Studio, import local media and documents into the project, read a project before editing, apply verified timeline edits, generate image/video/music assets, render voice, export the finished cut, and check durable jobs through the hosted Aixcut MCP server.

Read my Aixcut project before editing it.
